## Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Feature Type

- [ ] Orchestration Improvement (e.g., durable execution, event-driven workflow)
- [ ] Observability / Evaluation Enhancement
- [ ] Security / Guardrails Improvement
- [ ] Documentation Improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Motivation

Why is this feature valuable? How does it improve the AI agents workflow or learning?

## Detailed Description

Describe the feature in detail.
